title: Out-of-Network Visit Share: Calculation of the Per-Visit Amount
content:
The out-of-network visit share on an Out-of-Network Referral (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) is the office-visit copay recorded on the patient's Patient Financial Account.

## Calculation

1. **Copay.** The copay of the share is the office-visit copay recorded on the patient's Patient Financial Account, that is, the primary care office-visit copay recorded there.
2. **Deductible part.** The deductible part of the out-of-network visit share is the deductible basis multiplied by the collection rate and divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent, and never more than the financial class's time-of-service collection cap.
3. **Share.** The acknowledged out-of-network visit share is the copay and the deductible part together, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Office-visit copay | Deductible basis | Collection rate | Class cap | Deductible part | Share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30.00 | 0.00 | zero | 200.00 | 0.00 | 30.00 |
| 30.00 | 250.00 | 20 percent | 200.00 | 50.00 | 80.00 |
| 30.00 | 1,500.00 | 20 percent | 200.00 | 300.00 held to the cap: 200.00 | 230.00 |
| 25.00 | 187.65 | 15 percent | 200.00 | 28.1475, rounded to 28.15 | 53.15 |

In the last row the deductible part is rounded to the cent before it is compared with the cap and joined to the copay.
